title: Kalaignar Karunanidhi and the Assembly Wit: 'Electricity and the Wife'
summary: During a heated 1970s debate on frequent electrical load shedding, an agitated opposition member demanded: 'Is electricity a matter of government whim or public right?' Kalaignar defused the uproar with a brilliant linguistic pun on power and marriage, followed by hard thermal generation statistics.
keywords: Kalaignar Karunanidhi and the Assembly Wit: 'Electricity and the Wife'
full_text:
During the mid-1970s, monsoon failures led to acute power cuts across Tamil Nadu. The state Legislative Assembly was in an uproar as opposition MLAs mounted a blistering attack on the DMK ministry.

A fiery opposition member rose, waving a fist toward Chief Minister M. Karunanidhi:
"The Honorable Chief Minister boasts of industrial progress, yet in our villages, electricity behaves like an erratic phantom! When we expect power, it vanishes; when we sleep in the dark, it suddenly blinks on! What kind of power policy is this?"

Members thumped their desks in protest, demanding an immediate explanation.

Kalaignar Karunanidhi stood up with an amused twinkle in his eyes.

"The Honorable Member is entirely correct in his poetic frustration," Kalaignar began smoothly in sparkling Tamil. "Electricity and a devoted wife share an identical mystery in human life!"

The chamber quieted down, puzzled by the comparison.

Kalaignar continued with rhythmic wit:
"When electricity is constantly present in our homes, illuminating every corner without interruption, we take it for granted and barely pay it any attention or gratitude. But the very moment it departs—even for an hour—we immediately realize its supreme value, sit in darkness, and cry out its name! In modern times, managing both requires immense patience, steady current, and above all, avoiding high-voltage shocks!"

The entire assembly—including the agitated member who raised the question—burst into uncontrollable laughter.

Having dissolved the tension, Kalaignar immediately transitioned into solemn administration:
"Now, on the serious side, let me place before this House the exact coal supply charts from Ennore Thermal Station and the steps taken to secure grid transfers from Neyveli..."

The debate concluded constructively, showcasing Karunanidhi's legendary capacity to tame legislative storms with literary repartee.
